svg.text: Not a Switch-Packed Jet Cockpit — A Steering-Wheel-Free Cybercab

g.text: Traditional Heavy AI Workbenches (Piloting a Jet Cockpit)
Learn space trees & drag kanban cards
Turns you into a workflow plumber
You: Overwhelmed inside a switch-packed cockpit
Operating the tool itself is harder than your actual project
Study tutorials & workspace concepts first, then wrestle with cockpit panels
Summon Bot (A Cybercab Without Even a Steering Wheel)
No Steering Wheel or Dashboard — Just Familiar Group Chat
You: “Let’s build a maritime route game with an offline report…”
Zero concepts to learn: state your destination and the ride starts
No steering wheel or dashboard: just chat your destination and self-drive there
